evidence: Operating margin was 32.1% in the completed quarter, compared to 30.0% in the prior-year quarter.
reference_rationale: The evidence states historical margin figures for the completed quarter only and says nothing about next quarter at all -- no forward statement, no guidance, no next-quarter figure.
